newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index up in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index up in quiet trading.

text.p: The share index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius gained 1.17 points to 361.09 in a quiet trading session on Monday, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 6.07 million rupees on 249,931 shares from 13.37 million rupees on 566,680 shares last Friday.
Brokers said the index gained ground under the thrust of buying interests targetted at a few leading shares while volume was moderate relative to the last few trading sessions.
"The Semdex (index) is gaining ground mainly because of rising prices of the leading shares," one broker said." With volume moderate, it's far from being a general price rise across the board."
The rise of leading stock prices was seen as being led by State Bank of Mauritius which gained 10 cents to 10.80 rupees on 22,300 shares.
"In addition to their good outlook among analysts, State Bank shares will also be part of the Port Louis Fund," a dealer said.

The Port Louis Fund, a new country fund which is expected to start operating during the first quarter of 1997, would inject 900 million rupees ($45 million) to buy stakes in state linked companies such as State Bank of Mauritius and national carrier Air Mauritius and 300 million rupees in Mauritius bourse.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 82 rupees on 11,910 shares. Building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products gained 1.50 rupees to 36.50 on 1,050 shares.

Conglomerates Rogers was 2.0 rupees higher to 96 rupees on 20,734 shares and Ireland Blyth rose 30 cents to 15.30 rupees on 11,080 shares. Commerce-based Courts was up 30 cents to 6 rupees on 12,000 shares but Happy World Foods lost 50 cents to 16.50 rupees on 7,000 shares.

Shares in the hotel sector lost ground after price rises from a recent buying spell was seen as losing steam. Grand Baie Hotel was down 20 cents to 41.50 rupees on 5,100 shares, New Mauritius Hotels lost 30 cents to 32.30 rupees on 450 shares and Sun Resorts was off 30 cents to 39.80 rupees on 3,166 shares.
Air Mauritius was unchanged at 43.40 rupees on 1,600 shares.
